title: 第二十三章局势
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
温言劝走了那位一时迷惘的师妹，季南北抬手拭了拭额角的薄汗。

    “呼，今日也算行了一桩善事，功德无量。”

    随后，他随口说道:

    “说起来，你的魅力可真不小，简直堪称男女通吃。”

    萧京溪默然不语。

    季南北略感疑惑。

    相处这些时日，萧京溪与他已颇为熟稔，甚至有些话多或许因平日少与他人交谈，每逢季南北降临，她常是话语不断的。

    今日怎么反倒安静了?

    此时，萧京溪忽然出声，嗓音带着一丝微颤。

    “你......莫非已有道侣了?”

    在萧京溪想来，季南北对情爱之事见解如此透彻，定是已有道侣，且感情甚笃!

    什么白首不离......

    绝不能接受!完全无法接受!

    季南北并不知晓萧京溪脑中已演完一出大戏，只是摇了摇头。

    “没有啊。”

    “她居然能接受......啊?没有!?”

    险些脱口而出某些危险言辞的萧京溪，终于在悬崖边勒马，及时改了口。

    季南北虽觉有些古怪，却也未深究。

    “说起来，过两日便要离开仙灵剑宗，前往其他宗门拜访了吧。”季南北记得日子差不多了。

    “嗯，两日后便启程前往道宗。”

    道宗，顾名思义，乃是道统一脉的正宗，亦是当世四大宗门之一。

    事实上，早年道宗方为最强宗门，而非仙灵剑宗这等剑修门户。

    不过百年前道佛相争，双方打得元气大伤，恰于此时有人横空出世，方成就了仙灵剑宗今日地位。

    那人便是剑青城--萧京溪的师尊，亦是一宗之主。

    剑青城修为深不可测，此事暂且按下，容后再叙。

    “说来这修真界，四宗九派，为何此次只拜访其中两宗三派?”

    季南北有些好奇。

    “因四宗之中，有一宗乃是魔门，名为拜月魔宗。”

    萧京溪说起她所知的大势格局。
content_en:
Wen Yan persuaded the junior sister who was confused for a while, and Ji Nanbei raised his hand to wipe the thin sweat from his forehead.

    "Huh, I have done a good deed today and my merits are immeasurable."

    Then, he said casually:

    "Speaking of which, your charm is really great. It can be said to be suitable for both men and women."

    Xiao Jingxi remained silent.

    Ji Nanbei was slightly confused.

    After spending these days together, Xiao Jingxi became quite familiar with him, and she even talked a lot. Perhaps because she rarely talked to others on weekdays, whenever the season came, she would always talk non-stop.

    Why is it so quiet today?

    At this time, Xiao Jingxi suddenly spoke up, with a slight tremor in his voice.

    "You...do you already have a Taoist partner?"

    Xiao Jingxi thought that since Ji Nanbei had such a thorough understanding of love affairs, he must have had a Taoist couple and they were very affectionate!

    Why stay together forever...

    Absolutely unacceptable! Totally unacceptable!

    Ji Nanbei didn't know that a big drama had been played out in Xiao Jingxi's mind, so he just shook his head.

    "No."

    "She can actually accept it...ah? No!?"

    Xiao Jingxi, who almost blurted out some dangerous words, finally reined in her horse at the edge of the cliff and changed her words in time.

    Although Ji Nanbei thought it was a bit strange, he didn't dig into it.

    "Speaking of which, I will leave the Fairy Spirit Sword Sect in two days and visit other sects." Ji Nanbei remembered that the day was almost here.

    "Well, we will set off for Daozong in two days."

    Dao Sect, as the name suggests, is the authentic sect of the unified lineage of Dao, and is also one of the four major sects in the world.

    In fact, in the early years, the Dao Sect was the strongest sect, not a sword cultivation sect such as the Fairy Spirit Sword Sect.

    However, a hundred years ago, Taoism and Buddhism fought, and both sides were severely injured. At this time, someone came out of the blue, and it was only then that the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect achieved its current status.

    That person was Jian Qingcheng, Xiao Jingxi's master and the master of the sect.

    Jian Qingcheng's cultivation level is unfathomable, so I will suppress this matter for now and will talk about it later.

    "Speaking of this world of cultivation, there are four sects and nine sects. Why did you only visit two and three of them this time?"

    Ji Nanbei was a little curious.

    "Because among the four sects, one is a demon sect, called the Moon Worshiping Demon Sect."

    Xiao Jingxi talked about the general trend she knew.
